editorial:
You follow Mike Banning, a tough Secret Service agent, as he travels to London for the Prime Minister's funeral. What starts as a solemn event turns into chaos when terrorists attack world leaders gathered in the city. Banning has to protect the President and fight his way through the streets. The vibe is loud, fast, and packed with explosions from start to finish.

The action is nonstop and the stunts are big. Gerard Butler brings his usual tough-guy charm and keeps things moving. The story is simple and sometimes silly, but it delivers the thrills you want from a popcorn movie. Pros include great action and a fast pace. Cons include a thin plot and some cheesy lines. If you want a fun, no-brainer action flick, this hits the spot. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Banning tracks down the terrorist leader and kills him after a brutal fight. The President survives and returns home safely. The twist is that the attack was planned with help from inside, but Banning uncovers the truth. London begins to rebuild, and Banning heads back to his family, ready for whatever comes next.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves big action movies and tough heroes.
